facts.text: Kay, you worked here once. Trust me, flash yourself and the whole menu comes back.
facts.why: K never worked at Ben's. He hid a locker key there. Memory comes back through the deneuralyzer, not by flashing himself (he had neuralyzed himself and the memories had not returned).
facts.fix: Kay, you've eaten here before. Trust me, the deneuralyzer brings it all back, and the pizza helps.
